title: Artemis III Crew Tours High Bay 3
description: NASA astronauts Randy Bresnik, Artemis III commander; Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio, both Artemis III mission specialists; along with ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Luca Parmitano, Artemis III pilot; and NASA astronaut Bob Hines, Artemis III backup crew member, view the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket core stage and its solid rocket boosters since integration inside High Bay 3 at the Vehicle Assembly Building at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026. The crew will launch on the Artemis III mission to conduct critical rendezvous and docking tests with lunar lander systems in low Earth orbit, advancing the capabilities needed before astronauts return to the lunar surface on Artemis IV.
